scenes.title: A watch meters stored spring energy
The mainspring stores and releases energy
The gear train carries motion to the hands
The balance wheel sets a steady rhythm

vo.text: A mechanical watch keeps time using stored spring energy instead of a battery.
vo.speak: A mechanical watch keeps time using stored spring energy instead of a battery.

vo.text: Its clever mechanism releases that energy in tiny, evenly timed steps.
vo.speak: Its clever mechanism releases that energy in tiny, evenly timed steps.

vo.text: When you wind the watch, you tighten a mainspring inside a small drum called the barrel.
vo.speak: When you wind the watch, you tighten a mainspring inside a small drum called the barrel.

vo.text: The mainspring slowly unwinds, turning the barrel and feeding energy into a series of gears.
vo.speak: The mainspring slowly unwinds, turning the barrel and feeding energy into a series of gears.

vo.text: This gear train carries rotation toward the watch hands while reducing the motion into useful speeds.
vo.speak: This gear train carries rotation toward the watch hands while reducing the motion into useful speeds.

vo.text: But left alone, the spring would release its energy much too quickly.
vo.speak: But left alone, the spring would release its energy much too quickly.

vo.text: The escapement meters that energy, allowing the gears to advance one small step at a time.
vo.speak: The escapement meters that energy, allowing the gears to advance one small step at a time.

vo.text: A balance wheel oscillates back and forth at a steady rate, telling the escapement when each step may happen.
vo.speak: A balance wheel oscillates back and forth at a steady rate, telling the escapement when each step may happen.

vo.text: So the watch combines a steady oscillator, a controlled escapement, and gears to turn spring energy into accurate time.
vo.speak: So the watch combines a steady oscillator, a controlled escapement, and gears to turn spring energy into accurate time.
